MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Carpenters to join our growing team on a full-time basis.
About the Role

As a Carpenter, you will be responsible for constructing, installing, repairing, and maintaining timber and metal structures used across mining, industrial, commercial, and construction projects. You will work closely with supervisors, engineers, and other trades to ensure all carpentry work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project specifications and Australian Standards.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret construction drawings, plans, blueprints, and specifications.
•	Measure, cut, shape, assemble, and install timber, plywood, steel framing, and other building materials.

•	Carry out maintenance and repair work on existing buildings, structures, and site facilities.

Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Job Title: 		Metal Fabricator
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date:	30 days

About the Role
On behalf of our client - a leading structural steel fabricator specialising in commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects - we are seeking an experienced Metal Fabricator. The company operates a state-of-the-art facility with advanced CNC, plasma cutting, and automated welding equipment, delivering precision-engineered steelwork for high-profile builds. This role is critical to maintaining their reputation for quality, safety, and on-time delivery.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
Preparation & Planning
• Interpret complex blueprints, shop drawings, and specifications to determine material requirements, weld symbols, and assembly sequences.
• Conduct material take-offs and plan efficient cutting layouts to minimise waste, liaising with detailers and project managers.

Cutting & Shaping
• Operate CNC plasma cutters, oxy-fuel torches, and band saws to cut structural steel sections (beams, columns, channels) to precise dimensions.
• Shape and bend metal sections and pipes using hydraulic presses, rollers, and manual methods (heating, hammering) to achieve required profiles.

Assembly & Joining
• Align and tack components using clamps, jigs, and measuring instruments (levels, squares, tape measures) to ensure dimensional accuracy.
• Join steel sections via flux-cored arc welding (FCAW), MIG, or stick welding, as well as bolting and riveting for field connections.

Finishing & Quality Control
• Inspect welds for bead width, penetration, and uniformity; perform non-destructive testing (visual, dye penetrant) as required.
• Grind, file, and polish welds and surfaces to specified finish; apply protective coatings or acid washes to prevent corrosion.

Essential Qualifications & Experience
• Certificate III in Engineering - Fabrication Trade or equivalent qualification
• Minimum 2 years' post-apprenticeship experience in metal fabrication and welding within an industrial environment
• Proficiency in reading engineering drawings and using manual/machine tools.
• Strong welding skills (FCAW/MIG) and knowledge of Australian welding standards.
• Commitment to workplace safety and quality assurance.

Essential Skills & Attributes
• Exceptional attention to detail with commitment to producing high-quality craftsmanship
• Strong problem-solving skills with ability to troubleshoot fabrication and welding challenges
• Physical capability to handle heavy materials and work in demanding industrial environments
• Excellent teamwork and communication skills with ability to collaborate effectively with tradespeople and engineers
• Reliability and strong work ethic with commitment to meeting project deadlines and quality standards
• Adaptability to work across diverse projects and willingness to continuously develop technical skills

To Apply
If you are an experienced Metal Fabricator/Welder seeking a permanent role with an industry leader, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications through the application portal.

Please note: We are managing this recruitment process on behalf of our client. All applications will be reviewed by our team before being presented to the client.

We have been making an impression since 1903 — making us Australia's oldest signage company. From our Sunshine West facility we design, fabricate, install and maintain signage for some of the country's best-known brands, covering everything from illuminated pylon signs and shopfronts through to large-format architectural and retail projects.

Our workshop is the heart of the business. We are looking for a skilled Fabricator / Welder to join our production team.

Fabricate sign frames, lightboxes, pylon structures, brackets and mounting hardware

result.description:
Located in Yatala, GCI is the perfect location for Gold Coast and Brisbane living.

Over the last 20 years the GCI Group has introduced some of the latest start of the art technology to deliver world-class results that represent the very best in local manufacturing such as transport, mining, electrical, agriculture, construction, and defence.

About the role:
Due to growth within our business, we are looking for full time Welders to join our team. Reporting to the Foreman, you will be a part of a capable and motivated team who strive for excellence and will undertake a wide range of general assisting activities throughout the business.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

Why work with GCI?

By being part of our team, you’ll:
Learn from industry veterans and receive frequent training opportunities.
Work in a clean, professional, and supportive environment.
Become part of a team that genuinely invests in the community.
Enjoy competitive rates, frequent staff perks and a positive workplace culture.

If you’re interested in this fantastic opportunity, hit the "Apply Now" button with your current resume and brief cover letter.
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
Phillip Riley are looking for an experienced Organisation and Methods Analyst to join our team.

As an Organisation and Methods Analyst, you will support the continuous improvement of business operations by analysing organisational structures, workflows, and processes. Your role will involve recommending and implementing strategies to enhance customer experience and resource efficiency.

Main tasks include:

assisting and encouraging the development of objectives, strategies and plans aimed at achieving optimal customer experience and satisfaction and the effective use of organisations' resources and capabilities
identifying business and organisational gaps and opportunities through application of continuous improvement and change methodologies
analysing and evaluating current systems, capabilities and structures
advising clients on recommendations based on analysis of current-state gaps to provide solutions to organisational problems
preparing and recommending proposals to revise methods and procedures, alter work flows, redefine job functions and support organisational innovation and improvements
assisting in implementing approved recommendations
providing coaching and mentoring to individuals and teams to build specific capabilities
Key skills:

This role requires strong analytical thinking, excellent communication, and a deep understanding of business process improvement methodologies. A qualification at the bachelor level or higher is required, though equivalent work experience of 5+ years is also acceptable.

Minimum of 1 year's experience required

Please note that only successful candidates will be contacted.

Salary $87,500 - $107,500 + Superannuation

result.description: McHugh Steel   About the Role   This role would be ideally suited to someone who can assist in civil engineering research, design, construction, operations and maintenance.   We are seeking someone with experience in the building industry who has extensive knowledge of house frames, trusses and common building codes and practices – enabling them to quote/draw plans.  The candidate is required to have excellent computer skills – email correspondence, drafting quotes in word and PDF, experience with drawing in EnduroCAD, FrameCAD and AutoCAD (or similar program).    Responsibilities:    Detailing of Steel Houses & Commercial Projects in EnduroCAD Software.  Creating accurate CAD drawings from hand sketches, engineered plans, verbal instructions, and site visits.   Seamlessly integrating and working with management, builders, project managers design consultants, and sub-contractors, to produce and alter drawings.  Thinking creatively and critically to support the project/sales team in the design process, to create accurate steel framing constructions.   Creating and continually updating project drawings lists.   Printing various formats of drawing sets for project managers and site managers.  Systematically saving sketches and drawings on our CAD server; keeping the server organized; updating project folders and files as jobs progress and revisions are made.  Exhaustively reviewing and checking sketches and drawings for errors, before being sent to architects, subcontractors, project managers, etc.   Seeking clarity and understanding from engineers and project managers when you are not 100% certain of something.  Organizing and uploading drawings to web-based storage sites/collaboration project sites to share drawings with project and subcontractors.   Create, edit, and update standard details for use in projects.    Skills / Abilities     Applicants should hold a relevant qualification in Civil Engineering at diploma level or higher, or alternatively at least 3 years of relevant work experience.  Further studies to advance skills are an advantage  Extensive knowledge of house frames, trusses   Knowledge of common Australian Building Codes and practices  Ability to read house/building plans  Excellent computer skills  Experience drawing in EnduroCAD and FrameCAD (or similar programs)  Excellent self-organisation skills  Excellent communication ability  Initiative to improve our business processes   Successful candidate if requiring visa sponsorship will receive at least the TSMIT/CSIT of $79,500.  If you feel you meet our requirements, please submit your cover letter and resume.   About Company     McHugh Steel was established in 1992 as Outback Sheds then McHugh Constructions and finally as McHugh Steel by Robert McHugh & Sonja Pressler-McHugh. They have been a huge part of the steep evolution as the company is Australian and family owned. Their main aim is to provide Queensland with personalized constructions and meet their customers needs. They pay particular attention to individual needs by offering flexibility in design and finishes as well as ensuring the best team, products and service are put forward.
